Hi Lina — thanks for flagging this. Short answer: we treat the audit period inclusively by date, but we also provide a bridge letter when a migration/rollforward straddles the period boundary and there are material operations that fall after the stated period.

A few clarifications that will help your auditor:
- The SOC 2 Type II report covers the period up to and including 2026-06-30T23:59:59 UTC by timestamp; our primary evidence set is drawn from systems and logs with UTC timestamps.
- For scheduled migrations where a small maintenance window crosses into the next UTC day, we provide a "bridge letter" that documents the migration, the controls applied during the window (change approvals, change freeze start/end, verification steps), and confirms how we mapped post-migration artifacts back to the period.

I'm attaching the SOC2 report we issued and a working draft of the bridge letter. The bridge letter can reference specific artifacts (logs, deployment manifests, CI/CD run ids) — if your auditor needs specific identifiers we can add them.

Action items:
1) Monica — can you pull the deployment manifest + change approval record for HelioHealth migration window (Jun 30 23:40 UTC -> Jul 1 00:10 UTC)?
2) Priyom — please confirm whether we applied any live configuration drift checks immediately after rollforward and gather the post-deploy verification logs.

Lina, I'll follow up once Monica/Priyom confirm the artifact list and we will produce a signed bridge letter for your auditor.
